collection.description: A villager calls a neighboring tribe's carved totem frightening while praising a similarly imposing carving at home.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) calls a neighboring tribe's carved totem frightening while praising a similarly imposing carving at home.

choices.label: Ask What Makes the Carvings Different
Invite a Neighbor to Explain Theirs

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They explain that a childhood story, rather than the carving itself, shaped their fear.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (visitor) describes a protective meaning the village never knew.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (visitor) says meanings differ among families and cannot be reduced to one answer.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Both groups admire the careful carving and share techniques.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An argument over aesthetics turns into good-natured teasing.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They eventually admit the contradiction without being pressured.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They retain their preference while agreeing that dislike is not evidence of danger.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked
